description: RoundedTimeBar is a custom Android view extending DefaultTimeBar that renders a rounded, pill-shaped progress bar with custom drawing and thumb. It supports displaying unplayed, buffered, and played segments with Material 3 styling, and provides custom rendering logic overriding default behaviors.

classes.name: RoundedTimeBar
classes.description: A custom view extending DefaultTimeBar, implementing a rounded pill-shaped track with custom drawing for media progress.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Overrides default drawing to render custom rounded track and thumb for the time bar.

methods.name: drawRoundedTrackAndThumb
methods.description: Draws the rounded track segments (unplayed, buffered, played) and custom thumb positioned at the end of the played segment.

methods.name: setDuration
methods.description: Updates the total media duration; triggers redraw.

methods.name: setPosition
methods.description: Updates current playback position; triggers redraw.
